text: For seed 23 at d_model=256, what are the exact layer-1 and layer-3 force R2 values in probes_final for both the N=64 run (run-20261016-073808-5555) and the N=128 run (run-20261016-083515-124f)? Is the same-layer gap below 0.025 at layer 1 but at least 0.04 at layer 3? That would mean the N=128 deficit persists only in the later-layer force code that width builds at N=64.
